checks.finding: Context binds the preparation, original frozen schedule/argv/configuration/fit inputs, world/lock/source/package identities and original failed receipts/logs.
Execution requires matrix completion plus no live controller or validate_integration.py child, including cwd-relative .py.txt/.py paths; existing frozen native job guards remain active.
Global executor lock and under-lock original-state/attempt recheck precede the atomic one-use ledger claim; no outer GPU lock can deadlock nested native fitting.

Exact reviewed inventories reject unknown files, empty directories and symlinks; archive paths cannot overwrite existing evidence; mapping and verified same-filesystem renames preserve original bytes.
Only each named failed stage with its sole retained original failure and missing outputs can use the existing retry-failed command emitter. Exact frozen argv is required.

StopRequest and process-group termination, durable logs, native checkpoint/public-export byte rechecks with seal preexistence, exact fit-input binding and new attempt receipts are present. Completion status is refreshed only after the new receipt.
The group stops at the first new failure or interruption. A consumed ledger blocks automatic restart; partial archive/journal states require manual review.

execution_decision: Deferred to the parent after matrix controller and all children are terminal and final integrity checks pass.
limits: No --execute, archive, move, fitting, CUDA operation, protected-array read or production-source edit was performed by this reviewer.

The matrix completion gate uses the sealed driver completion record and report hashes. It is not an independent scientific audit of all32 fits; the planned end-of-matrix artifact audit remains required.
Matrix process termination and runtime state were not independently measured during this review.
Live interruption was not exercised; interruption handling was traced through the unchanged pinned StopRequest/stop_group primitives.
A stopped or failed archive consumes the one-use ledger and needs manual review; no automatic rollback or retry is promised.
Old baseline commands/settings remain separate from matrix-selected settings. This review does not authorize causal discovery on new settings.
scope: Only the two original constrained_chain_1 baseline stage IDs, realistic/informative seed0. Static source/test review and small metadata/source hash comparison only.

test_evidence.reason: Tests include temporary archive/execute paths; this independent review was explicitly read-only. Final delta and test cases were inspected, and file hashes independently confirmed.
